name: Drought
value: E Africa, S Africa, Australia wheat hit
summary: Super El Niño cuts Australian wheat and dries East Africa
state: FEWS NET (6 Oct) flags high concern for drought in Ethiopia, South Sudan, Sudan and southern Africa. Australia's wheat crop is forecast to fall 14–17%, India's rice 4.6%, and Pakistan's monsoon crops are below average. Global grain output is still projected as the second-largest on record. No new data as of 1 Nov.
for_you: Drought in exporting regions can add to food price pressures over the next year.
rubric_hit: Severe drought in a major crop region, a major river at record low, or a monsoon running more than 20% below normal.

sources.title: FEWS NET — 2026–2027 El Niño food security impacts
EC Joint Research Centre — El Niño weather extremes worsen food security

why: Drought slowly destroys harvests, hydropower and river shipping, and drives famine and migration.
drivers: Rainfall deficits, heat, ENSO, groundwater depletion.

rubric.alert: Drought driving famine conditions, a major exporter's harvest failure, or monsoon failure across a major breadbasket.
rubric.watch: Severe drought in a major crop region, a major river at record low, or a monsoon running more than 20% below normal.
rubric.normal: No major breadbasket in severe drought.
